# Menubar

> Desktop command bar with nested menus, shortcuts, and separators.

This file matches the installed `menubar` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/menubar.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/menubar.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`
- `popup-item-focus`
- `surface-variants`

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/button-knobs`: `buttonKnobs`, types `ButtonKnobStyle`

- `@/components/control-ui/ui/menubar`: `Menubar`, `MenubarMenu`, `MenubarTrigger`, `MenubarContent`, `MenubarGroup`, `MenubarItem`, `MenubarCheckboxItem`, `MenubarRadioGroup`, `MenubarRadioItem`, `MenubarLabel`, `MenubarSeparator`, `MenubarShortcut`, `MenubarSub`, `MenubarSubTrigger`, `MenubarSubContent`, types `MenubarProps`, `MenubarMenuProps`, `MenubarTriggerProps`, `MenubarContentProps`, `MenubarGroupProps`, `MenubarItemProps`, `MenubarCheckboxItemProps`, `MenubarRadioGroupProps`, `MenubarRadioItemProps`, `MenubarSeparatorProps`, `MenubarLabelProps`, `MenubarShortcutProps`, `MenubarSubProps`, `MenubarSubTriggerProps`, `MenubarSubContentProps`

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

import {
  Menubar,
  MenubarCheckboxItem,
  MenubarContent,
  MenubarGroup,
  MenubarItem,
  MenubarLabel,
  MenubarMenu,
  MenubarRadioGroup,
  MenubarRadioItem,
  MenubarSeparator,
  MenubarShortcut,
  MenubarSub,
  MenubarSubContent,
  MenubarSubTrigger,
  MenubarTrigger,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/menubar";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

export function PrimitiveMenubarExample() {
  const [last, setLast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const run = (label: string) => () => setLast(label);
  const [sidebarVisible, setSidebarVisible] = useState(true);
  const [statusBarVisible, setStatusBarVisible] = useState(false);
  const [density, setDensity] = useState("comfortable");

  return (
    <div className="flex max-w-xl flex-col gap-6">
      <Menubar aria-label="Editor">
        <MenubarMenu>
          <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
          <MenubarContent>
            <MenubarGroup>
              <MenubarLabel>Document</MenubarLabel>
              <MenubarItem onClick={run("New file")}>
                New file
                <MenubarShortcut>⌘N</MenubarShortcut>
              </MenubarItem>
              <MenubarItem onClick={run("Open…")}>
                Open…
                <MenubarShortcut>⌘O</MenubarShortcut>
              </MenubarItem>
            </MenubarGroup>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarSub>
              <MenubarSubTrigger>Export</MenubarSubTrigger>
              <MenubarSubContent>
                <MenubarItem onClick={run("Export PDF")}>PDF</MenubarItem>
                <MenubarItem onClick={run("Export PNG")}>PNG</MenubarItem>
                <MenubarItem onClick={run("Export SVG")}>SVG</MenubarItem>
              </MenubarSubContent>
            </MenubarSub>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarItem onClick={run("Print")}>
              Print
              <MenubarShortcut>⌘P</MenubarShortcut>
            </MenubarItem>
          </MenubarContent>
        </MenubarMenu>

        <MenubarMenu>
          <MenubarTrigger>Edit</MenubarTrigger>
          <MenubarContent>
            <MenubarItem onClick={run("Undo")}>
              Undo
              <MenubarShortcut>⌘Z</MenubarShortcut>
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem onClick={run("Redo")}>
              Redo
              <MenubarShortcut>⇧⌘Z</MenubarShortcut>
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarItem onClick={run("Cut")}>Cut</MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem onClick={run("Copy")}>Copy</MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem onClick={run("Paste")}>Paste</MenubarItem>
          </MenubarContent>
        </MenubarMenu>

        <MenubarMenu>
          <MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>
          <MenubarContent>
            <MenubarGroup>
              <MenubarLabel>Panels</MenubarLabel>
              <MenubarCheckboxItem checked={sidebarVisible} onCheckedChange={setSidebarVisible}>
                Sidebar
              </MenubarCheckboxItem>
              <MenubarCheckboxItem checked={statusBarVisible} onCheckedChange={setStatusBarVisible}>
                Status bar
              </MenubarCheckboxItem>
            </MenubarGroup>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarGroup>
              <MenubarLabel>Density</MenubarLabel>
              <MenubarRadioGroup value={density} onValueChange={setDensity}>
                <MenubarRadioItem value="compact">Compact</MenubarRadioItem>
                <MenubarRadioItem value="comfortable">Comfortable</MenubarRadioItem>
              </MenubarRadioGroup>
            </MenubarGroup>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarItem onClick={run("Zoom in")}>Zoom in</MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem onClick={run("Zoom out")}>Zoom out</MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem disabled>Reset zoom</MenubarItem>
          </MenubarContent>
        </MenubarMenu>
      </Menubar>

      <Text size="caption" tone="muted">
        {last ? `Last action: ${last}` : "No action yet"}
      </Text>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `menubar`
  - `checkbox-item`: `data-checked`, `data-disabled`, `data-highlighted`, `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`), `data-unchecked`

  - `group`: `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`)
  - `item`: `data-disabled`, `data-highlighted`, `data-inset`, `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`), `data-tone` (`danger` | `neutral`)
  - `label`: `data-inset`, `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`)
  - `radio-group`: `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`)
  - `radio-item`: `data-checked`, `data-disabled`, `data-highlighted`, `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`), `data-unchecked`
  - `root`: `data-has-submenu-open`, `data-modal`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`)
  - `separator`: `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`)
  - `shortcut`: `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`)
  - `sub-content`: `data-align` (`center` | `end` | `start`), `data-closed`, `data-ending-style`, `data-instant` (`click` | `dismiss` | `group` | `trigger-change`), `data-open`, `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`), `data-side` (`bottom` | `inline-end` | `inline-start` | `left` | `right` | `top`), `data-starting-style`
  - `sub-trigger`: `data-disabled`, `data-highlighted`, `data-inset`, `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`), `data-popup-open`
  - `sub-trigger-indicator`: `data-icon-dir` (`inline`), `data-popup-kind` (`menubar`)
